name: Skyview Lab Blueberry Farm
description: In 480 Willison Road, PA, Skyview Lab Blueberry Farm grows Strawberries, Blueberries, Raspberries, Blackberries, and Apples on a small pumpkin patch. The harvest is typically at its peak in summer. The season runs through spring, summer, and autumn. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Apr – Jun in this growing zone.
